name: Alchemix USD
oneLiner: alUSD is Alchemix's self-repaying CDP stablecoin: users borrow against DAI/USDC/USDT collateral and the yield from those deposits gradually repays the debt.
collateral: DAI, USDC, and USDT deposited into yield strategies (Yearn, Aave) via Alchemix CDPs; yield automatically repays debt
pegMechanism: Self-repaying loans: yield from deposited stablecoin collateral automatically repays debt; Transmuter guarantees 1:1 redemption

oracleRisk.summary: Alchemix alUSD loans are self-repaying and non-liquidating, so the CDP path does not rely on an external liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: Alchemix documents alUSD loans as self-repaying and non-liquidating. A borrower may self-liquidate by repaying debt with collateral, but the protocol does not forcibly liquidate borrower positions, so there is no market-specific oracle and collateral-liquidation branch to enumerate.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Arbitrum block 0x1cd87f90, the tracked proxy 0xcb8fa9a76b8e203d8c3797bf438d8fb81ea3326a stored implementation 0x37704b70cba0ffd12eb039274ff46992544a1f16 and ProxyAdmin 0xa44f69aeac480e23c0abfa9a55d99c9f098beac6, whose owner() was 0x7e108711771dfdb10743f016d46d75a9379ca043. At Optimism block 0x9318364, the same proxy address stored implementation 0x29ef9f2fa6f636eafe74e5fba057c7949a37ffa6 and the same ProxyAdmin, whose owner() was 0xc224bf25dcc99236f00843c7d8c4194abe8aa94a. Sourcify exactly verifies both material L2 implementations and the owner-only OpenZeppelin ProxyAdmin. Those owners can replace holder-facing token implementations and introduce per-holder transfer or balance restrictions. The current L2 source has standard transfer paths and only pauses minters; Ethereum's setBlacklist likewise targets a minter rather than an alUSD holder. This is an upgrade-control finding, not an assertion of a live or uniform holder blacklist across every deployment.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: alUSD is minted by the AlchemistV2 contract when users deposit DAI/USDC/USDT collateral. The AlToken (alUSD) grants ADMIN_ROLE to two holders: a MultiSigWalletWithTimeLock (7 EOA owners, 4-of-7, 10-minute timelock) and a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (7 EOA owners, 3-of-7, no modules, no guard). The Safe also owns the AlchemistV2 ProxyAdmin (upgrade rights). Neither ADMIN_ROLE holder can mint directly; they govern parameters and upgrade the AlchemistV2 CDP logic.

controls.label: AlchemistV2 (CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: Per-synthetic global mint limit that linearly cools down over time; minting only against deposited collateral up to ~50% LTV.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295217, AlchemistV2 proxy at 0x5C6374a2ac4EBC38DeA0Fc1F8716e5Ea1AdD94dd (impl 0x0f17d8...) is the active CDP minter; EIP-1967 admin slot points to ProxyAdmin 0xe0fc5cb7665041cda26969a2d1ceb5cd5046347d.

controls.label: Alchemix MultiSigWalletWithTimeLock (ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295217, MultiSigWalletWithTimeLock at 0x8392f6669292fa56123f71949b52d883ae57e225 holds ADMIN_ROLE on the AlToken (alUSD). getOwners() returned 7 EOA addresses; required()=4; storage slot 6 = 600 seconds (10-minute timelock); slot 4 = 4 (threshold). All 7 owners confirmed EOA via eth_getCode.

controls.label: Alchemix Gnosis Safe (ADMIN_ROLE + ProxyAdmin owner)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295217, Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 at 0x9e2b6378ee8ad2a4a95fe481d63caba8fb0ebbf9 holds ADMIN_ROLE on AlToken (via getRoleMember check) AND owns the AlchemistV2 ProxyAdmin (0xe0fc5cb7..., slot0=0x9e2b6378...). getOwners()=7 EOAs, getThreshold()=3, getModulesPaginated() returns empty array, guard slot=0x0, masterCopy slot0=0xd9db270c... (Safe 1.3.0).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295217: AlToken (alUSD, 0xbc6da0fe...) ADMIN_ROLE (0xdf8b4c52...) has 2 members: MultiSigWalletWithTimeLock (0x8392f6..., 4/7 EOA owners, 10-min timelock) and Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (0x9e2b6378..., 3/7 EOA owners, no modules, no guard). The Safe also owns ProxyAdmin (0xe0fc5cb7...) which controls the AlchemistV2 CDP proxy upgrade path. All owners confirmed EOA via eth_getCode. No centralized direct-mint path; AlchemistV2 is the only CDP minter.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Alchemix documents alAsset L2 bridging through Everclear xERC20 plus lockbox contracts; mainnet alUSD can be locked and L2 xalUSD minted, with Everclear as the whitelisted bridge path.

reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 25530459, the Ethereum AlchemistV2 expectedValue for every registered yield token was aggregated by its on-chain underlying token. The resulting controller-local mix was 80.2263% DAI, 15.9306% USDC, 0.3867% USDT, and 3.4564% FRAX, rounded to one decimal while preserving a 100% total. Each observed slice maps to its exact tracked stablecoin dependency. Alchemix also documents locally minted Optimism and Arbitrum xalUSD backed by chain-local future yield plus bridged Mainnet alUSD; those controllers, bridge lockboxes, Transmuters, and AMO balances are not reconciled in this Ethereum-only snapshot, so it is retained as selected-slice evidence rather than an asset-wide composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ethereum AlchemistV2 getSupportedYieldTokens() and getYieldTokenParameters().expectedValue aggregated by underlying token at Ethereum block 25530459
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All registered yield-token expected values in the observed Ethereum Alchemist were attributed to their on-chain underlying stablecoins; asset-wide L2, bridge, Transmuter, and AMO exposure remains unreconciled outside this selected slice.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is deposited non-custodially into AlchemistV2 and routed into registered Yearn/Aave yield strategies, so custody is contract-based rather than with a legal custodian; legal segregation and insolvency treatment do not apply at the protocol layer, and underlying stablecoin issuers retain their own custody and freeze postures.
